about: PPC and trade trainer (docs/apmacro-spec.md section 6, builder T3). The PPC is ApMacroGraph's ppc kind; the countries, events and every number live in macroeconomics/assets/tools/math/ppc-trade.js (ApMacroCalc recipes); a context unlocks with its topic. Checked by scripts/lib/apmacro-tool-checks/ppc-trade.mjs.
intro: Two views. PPC: slide along a production possibilities curve and watch each extra unit cost more of the other good; then shift the curve or push the economy inside it. Trade: two countries, two goods. Find who gives up less, let each specialize, and move the terms of trade: both gain only when the price lies between the two opportunity costs.
howItWorks:
• On the PPC: efficient. Inside: idle or wasted resources. Outside: not possible now.
  • More resources or better technology shift the PPC out; lost resources shift it in. A recession moves the economy inside the curve without moving it.
  • Bowed out: increasing opportunity cost. A straight line: constant opportunity cost.
  • Opportunity cost = what is given up ÷ what is gained. With output data (the most each can make), one unit of X costs Y ÷ X. With input data (hours per unit), it costs hours for X ÷ hours for Y.
  • Comparative advantage: the lower opportunity cost. Absolute advantage: more output, or fewer hours. Trade follows comparative advantage.
  • Terms of trade help both countries only when the price of one good lies strictly between the two countries' opportunity costs.
  • Keyboard: the point on the PPC graph takes the arrow keys.
